title: Risk-based hold length (US User Agreement)
quote: Risk-based holds generally remain in place for up to 21 days from the date the payment was received into your PayPal account.
source_name: PayPal US User Agreement — Holds, Limitations, and Reserves (last updated Nov 4, 2026)

title: Risk-based hold length (Hong Kong User Agreement)
quote: Risk-based holds generally remain in place for up to 30 days from the date the payment was received into your PayPal account unless PayPal has a reason to continue to hold the payment.
source_name: PayPal HK User Agreement (last updated 28 May 2026)

title: Earlier release is at PayPal's discretion
quote: We may release the hold earlier under certain circumstances (for example, if you've uploaded shipment tracking information related to the transaction), but any earlier release is at our sole discretion.
source_name: PayPal US User Agreement — Holds, Limitations, and Reserves (last updated Nov 4, 2026)

title: Who gets holds
quote: New sellers or sellers who have limited selling activity. Payments for higher-risk categories like electronics or tickets. Sellers who have performance issues, or a high rate of buyer dissatisfaction or disputes.
source_name: PayPal US User Agreement — Holds, Limitations, and Reserves (last updated Nov 4, 2026)

title: Release ~24h after delivery confirmation
quote: Add Tracking. Use one of our approved shipping carriers, and we'll release the hold approximately 24 hours after the courier confirms delivery to the buyer's address.
source_name: PayPal UK Help — How can I release my payment(s) on hold? (help129)

title: Disputed payments held until resolved (max 180 days)
quote: The hold may last longer than 21 days if the payment is challenged … we'll hold the payment in your PayPal account until the matter is resolved (but no longer than 180 days).
source_name: PayPal US User Agreement — Holds, Limitations, and Reserves (last updated Nov 4, 2026)

title: Reserves on business accounts
quote: We may place a reserve on your business account at any time if we believe there may be a high level of risk associated with you, your business account, your business model, or your transactions.
source_name: PayPal US User Agreement — Reserves placed on business accounts (last updated Nov 4, 2026)

title: Balance holds up to 180 days (limitation)
quote: Holding the balance in your Balance Account, the balance in your business account … for up to 180 days if reasonably needed to protect against the risk of liability or if you have violated our Acceptable Use Policy. The hold may remain in place longer than 180 days according to Court Orders, Regulatory Requirements, or Other Legal Processes.
source_name: PayPal US User Agreement — Restricted Activities, Holds, and Other Actions We May Take (last updated Nov 4, 2026)

title: Seller Protection scope: INR and unauthorized only
quote: PayPal's Seller Protection program may apply when buyer(s) claim that: They did not authorize, or benefit from, funds sent from their PayPal account (referred to as an "Unauthorized Transaction" claim) …; or They didn't receive the item from you (referred to as an "Item Not Received" claim)
source_name: PayPal US Seller Protection Program (last updated January 26, 2026)

title: Significantly Not as Described is excluded
quote: Items where the buyer claims (either with us or their card issuer) that the item you sent isn't what was ordered (referred to as a Significantly Not as Described claim).
source_name: PayPal US Seller Protection Program — Ineligible Items and Transactions (last updated January 26, 2026)

title: Guest Checkout / card payments excluded for CN, HK, SG sellers
quote: Payments not processed through a buyer's PayPal account, including PayPal Guest Checkout payments and Standard Credit and Debit Card Payments where the seller's account is registered in the following countries – Singapore, China, Hong Kong, Australia, Italy, France, …
source_name: PayPal US Seller Protection Program — Ineligible Items and Transactions (last updated January 26, 2026)

title: Proof of delivery requirements
quote: Online or physical documentation from a shipping company that includes: An online and verifiable tracking number. Date of delivery and 'delivered' status. An address for the recipient that matches the shipping address on the Transaction Details page. An address for the recipient showing at least the city/state, city/country, or zip/postal code (or international equivalent).
source_name: PayPal US Seller Protection Program (last updated January 26, 2026)

title: Carrier choice matters for international shipments
quote: IMPORTANT: Your choice of carrier and shipment options with that carrier can have a big impact on your ability to meet the proof of delivery requirements. Please ensure, especially when shipping goods internationally, that your carrier can provide 'delivered' status at the correct address, or your Seller Protection claim may be denied.
source_name: PayPal US Seller Protection Program (last updated January 26, 2026)

title: Seller must respond within 10 days
quote: You must respond within the first 10 days following a dispute creation. If you don't respond within these 10 days and the buyer escalates it to a claim, we will resolve the case in the buyer's favor.
source_name: PayPal US Help — How do I respond to INR and SNAD disputes? (HELP1083)

title: Buyer dispute windows (INR 180 days, SNAD 30 days)
quote: Dispute must be opened within 180 days of the date you sent the payment to the seller. … Dispute must be opened (i) within 30 days of the date of delivery or fulfillment (as applicable) of an order or (ii) within 180 days of the date you sent the payment to the seller, whichever is sooner.
source_name: PayPal US Purchase Protection Program (last updated January 26, 2026)

title: Dispute fee: when it applies
quote: The Dispute fee applies when the buyer pursues a claim directly with PayPal, a chargeback with their card issuer, or a reversal with their bank. … The Dispute fee will be deducted from your PayPal account after the claim is decided.
source_name: PayPal US User Agreement — Dispute fees (last updated Nov 4, 2026)

title: Standard dispute fee waived in some cases
quote: Deemed by PayPal in its sole discretion to have met all the requirements under PayPal's Seller Protection program … Decided in your favor by PayPal or your issuer.
source_name: PayPal US User Agreement — Dispute fees (last updated Nov 4, 2026)

title: Dispute & chargeback fee amounts (US account, fee table)
quote: Standard dispute fee (USD transactions): 15.00 USD. High Volume dispute fee: 30.00 USD. Chargeback fee: 20.00 USD.
source_name: PayPal US Business Fees (fee table; last updated November 4, 2026)

title: Dispute & chargeback fee amounts (HK and China cross-border accounts, fee table)
quote: Standard dispute fee (USD transactions): 8.00 USD. High Volume dispute fee: 16.00 USD. Chargeback fee: 10.00 USD.
source_name: PayPal HK Business Fees (07 Aug 2025) and PayPal C2 merchant fees (18 Jun 2025) — fee tables

title: No false or misleading information
quote: Provide false, inaccurate or misleading information regarding your identity, account or business, goods or services offered or purchased, transaction details…
source_name: PayPal US User Agreement — Restricted Activities (last updated Nov 4, 2026)
